execute_transition_with_state_manager: execute a registered FSM transition on a Django model entity with user context and transition data
get_target_state: get the target state for a transition using a minimal context with the entity and current user
handle_side_effect_only_transition: run a side-effect only transition that executes hooks without creating a state record
prepare_and_validate_transition: prepare and validate a transition by checking permissions and running pre-transition hooks
finalize_transition: finalize a transition after state record creation by running post-transition hooks
